title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-01-03
lineage: Master DAT > Panasonic SV-3700 > UA-5 > USB > WaveLab  Mastering in WaveLab with iZotope Ozone 4 > CD Wave > TLH > Flac

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with solid quality captures a strong early‑'70 set featuring standout Working Man's Dead, Cosmic Charlie, Mason’s Children and Wolf.
ai_review.review: The show is praised as one of the best early‑1970 performances, delivering memorable versions of Workingman's Dead material, a fantastic Cosmic Charlie, an especially beloved Mason's Children, and a beautiful rendition of Wolf. The Green Mountain Bros soundboard source is generally clear and well‑balanced, though reviewers note a few small cuts in the tape. Overall the performance and recording combine to make an uplifting listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Both detailed reviews rate the show 4 stars, highlighting strong musical moments and solid soundboard quality with only minor tape cuts; a third 5‑star review adds confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall solid sound with clear mix; a few small cuts are present but do not detract significantly from enjoyment.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows smoothly, showcasing strong early‑'70 material and maintaining energy throughout with well‑executed transitions.
